section.content: 本实用新型公开了一种锂离子电池。所述锂离子电池包括上金属壳体和下金属壳体，所述下金属壳体包括底壁、与所述底壁共同围设形成收容空间的侧壁，所述底壁与所述上金属壳体相对设置；所述锂离子电池还包括电池芯体和极柱，所述电池芯体收容于所述收容空间内，所述电池芯体包括第一极极耳引出端和第二极极耳引出端；所述极柱绝缘设置在所述侧壁上，所述第一极极耳引出端与所述极柱连接；所述第二极极耳引出端与所述侧壁或与所述底壁连接。本实用新型提供的锂离子电池能够提高锂离子电池的电池容量，从而提高锂离子电池的整体能量密度和续航时间。

The utility model discloses a lithium ion battery. The lithium ion battery comprises an upper metal shell and a lower metal shell, wherein the lower metal shell comprises a bottom wall and a side wall which is commonly enclosed with the bottom wall to form an accommodating space, and the bottom wall is opposite to the upper metal shell; the lithium ion battery also comprises a battery core body and a pole, wherein the battery core body is accommodated in the accommodating space, and the battery core body comprises a first pole tab leading-out end and a second pole tab leading-out end; the pole is arranged on the side wall in an insulating mode, and the first pole tab leading-out end is connected with the pole; and the second pole tab leading-out end is connected with the side wall or the bottom wall. The lithium ion battery provided by the utility model can improve the battery capacity of the lithium ion battery, thereby improving the overall energy density and the endurance time of the lithium ion battery.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the field of lithium ion battery manufacturing, in particular to a lithium ion battery and a preparation method thereof.

Background

In view of the high energy density and high mass density of lithium ion batteries, in recent years, lithium ion batteries are also used in energy systems of products such as portable electronic products and wearable products, and in addition, the difficulty of processing and manufacturing small lithium ion batteries is much higher than that of common 3C batteries, so that the market of small lithium ion batteries also has a phenomenon of short supply.

At present, a steel shell button type lithium ion battery is generally sealed by plastics, an upper metal negative pole cover plate and a lower metal negative pole box body are welded at a sealing part mainly through an ultrasonic welding process, a positive pole insulation part and a positive pole polarity central column are both arranged on the upper metal negative pole cover plate (generally, the center position of the central angle of the upper metal negative pole cover plate), and the positive pole insulation part can insulate the positive pole polarity central column from a negative pole so as to realize battery charging and discharging and performance testing.

However, the inventors found that the prior art has at least the following problems: the internal space size of the conventional lithium ion battery is not utilized more effectively, so that the battery capacity is low, and further, the overall energy density of the lithium ion battery is low and the endurance time is short.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model provides a lithium ion battery and a preparation method thereof, which can improve the battery capacity of the lithium ion battery, thereby improving the overall energy density and the endurance time of the lithium ion battery.

According to one aspect of the utility model, a lithium ion battery is provided, which comprises an upper metal shell and a lower metal shell, wherein the lower metal shell comprises a bottom wall and a side wall which forms an accommodating space together with the bottom wall, and the bottom wall is arranged opposite to the upper metal shell; the lithium ion battery also comprises a battery core body and a pole, wherein the battery core body is accommodated in the accommodating space, and the battery core body comprises a first pole tab leading-out end and a second pole tab leading-out end; the pole is arranged on the side wall in an insulating mode, and the first pole lug leading-out end is connected with the pole; and the second pole tab leading-out end is connected with the side wall or the bottom wall.

Additionally, the battery core includes a top portion adjacent the upper metal case, a bottom portion adjacent the bottom wall, and side edge portions connecting the top portion and the bottom portion; the first pole tab leading-out end is located at the edge of the side edge part close to the top, or the first pole tab leading-out end is located at the edge of the side edge part close to the bottom.

In addition, the second pole tab leading-out end is connected with the side wall and is positioned on the edge of the side edge part close to the bottom; or the second pole tab leading-out end is connected with the bottom wall and is positioned in the central area of the bottom.

In addition, the lithium ion battery further comprises an insulating tape; the insulating tape is provided between the upper metal case and the battery core, and/or the insulating tape is provided between the lower metal case and the battery core.

In addition, the lithium ion battery also comprises a liquid injection hole; the liquid injection hole is formed in the upper metal shell, or the liquid injection hole is formed in the side wall and is arranged at an interval with the pole.

In addition, the lithium ion battery also comprises a pressure relief groove; the pressure relief groove is provided on a side of the upper metal case adjacent to the battery core, and/or the pressure relief groove is provided on a side of the side wall adjacent to the battery core, and/or the pressure relief groove is provided on a side of the bottom wall adjacent to the battery core.

In addition, the pressure relief groove is provided on a side of the bottom wall adjacent to the battery core; the ratio of the groove depth of the pressure relief groove to the thickness of the bottom wall is greater than or equal to 0.25 and less than or equal to 0.95.

Compared with the related art, the embodiment of the utility model has at least the following advantages:

the pole is arranged on the side wall of the lower metal shell in an insulating mode, the first pole tab leading-out end is connected with the pole, and the second pole tab leading-out end is connected with the side wall or the bottom wall, so that the lithium ion battery can normally work on one hand, and the normal use of the lithium ion battery is not influenced; on the other hand, the pole column does not occupy the space of the lithium ion battery in the height direction of the battery, so that the accommodating space can be used for accommodating a battery core body with a larger size, the capacity of the battery is larger, and the overall energy density and the endurance time of the lithium ion battery are further improved.

It should be understood that the statements in this section are not intended to identify key or critical features of the embodiments of the present invention, nor are they intended to limit the scope of the utility model. Other features of the present invention will become apparent from the following description.

Detailed Description

In order to make those skilled in the art better understand the technical solutions of the present invention, the technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only a part of the embodiments of the present invention, and not all of the embodiments. All other embodiments, which can be obtained by a person skilled in the art without making any creative effort based on the embodiments in the present invention, shall fall within the protection scope of the present invention.

It should be noted that the terms "first," "second," and the like in the description and claims of the present invention and in the drawings described above are used for distinguishing between similar elements and not necessarily for describing a particular sequential or chronological order. It is to be understood that the data so used is interchangeable under appropriate circumstances such that the embodiments of the utility model described herein are capable of operation in other sequences than those illustrated or described herein. Moreover, the terms "comprises," "comprising," and "having," and any variations thereof, are intended to cover a non-exclusive inclusion, such that a process, method, system, article, or apparatus that comprises a list of steps or elements is not necessarily limited to those steps or elements expressly listed, but may include other steps or elements not expressly listed or inherent to such process, method, article, or apparatus.

Example one

Fig. 1 to fig. 4 are schematic structural diagrams of a lithium ion battery according to a first embodiment of the present invention, and please refer to fig. 1, a specific structure of the lithium ion battery includes:

the metal shell comprises an upper metal shell 1 and a lower metal shell 2, wherein the lower metal shell 2 comprises a bottom wall 21 and a side wall 22 which is arranged to surround the bottom wall 21 to form an accommodating space 20, and the bottom wall 21 is arranged opposite to the upper metal shell 1; the lithium ion battery also comprises a battery core body 3 and a pole 4, wherein the battery core body 3 is accommodated in the accommodating space 20, and the battery core body 3 comprises a first pole lug leading-out end 32 and a second pole lug leading-out end 31; the pole 4 is arranged on the side wall 22 in an insulating way, and the first pole lug leading-out end 32 is connected with the pole 4; the second pole tab terminal 31 is connected to the bottom wall 21.

Specifically, the battery core 3 includes a top portion 301 adjacent to the upper metal case 1, a bottom portion 302 adjacent to the bottom wall 21, and side edge portions 303 connecting the top portion 301 and the bottom portion 302; the first pole tab lead-out 32 is located at the edge of the side edge portion 303 near the top portion 301.

More specifically, the first electrode tab leading-out end 32 may be an anode electrode tab leading-out end, and the second electrode tab leading-out end 31 is a cathode electrode tab leading-out end; the first electrode tab leading-out end 32 may also be a negative electrode tab leading-out end, and at this time, the second electrode tab leading-out end 31 is a positive electrode tab leading-out end.

In addition, the second pole tab lead-out 31 shown in fig. 1 is located in the central region of the base 302. That is, the second pole tab leading end 31 is fixedly attached to the central region of the bottom wall 21.

It should be noted that both the upper metal shell 1 and the lower metal shell 2 shown in fig. 1 are circular, and in practical application, the shapes of the upper metal shell 1 and the lower metal shell 2 are not specifically limited.

It should be further noted that the battery core 3, the first pole tab leading-out end 32 and the second pole tab leading-out end 31 may be integrally formed, and the first pole tab leading-out end 32 and the second pole tab leading-out end 31 may also be connected with the battery core 3 in a welding manner, which is not specifically limited in the present embodiment by the connection manner of the battery core 3, the first pole tab leading-out end 32 and the second pole tab leading-out end 31.

Referring to fig. 2, the upper metal shell 1 and the lower metal shell 2 are both arc-shaped.

It should be noted that the bottom wall 21 and the side wall 22 shown in fig. 1 may be integrally formed, and in practical application, the bottom wall 21 and the side wall 22 may also be fixed together by laser ultrasonic welding or the like, that is, the present embodiment does not specifically limit the manufacturing process of the lower metal shell 2, and may be selected according to practical requirements.

Referring to fig. 3 and 4 together, the bottom wall 21 and the side wall 22 are separated into two parts.

Referring to fig. 1 to 2, the lithium ion battery further includes a liquid injection hole 10, and the liquid injection hole 10 is disposed on the upper metal casing 1. Specifically, during the preparation of the lithium ion battery, the electrolyte flows into the housing space 20 through the electrolyte injection port 10, and the electrolyte injection port 10 is sealed by laser ultrasonic welding or the like, thereby sealing the inside of the lithium ion battery from the outside.

Fig. 5 is a cross-sectional view of the post 4 and a portion of the sidewall 22 according to the present embodiment. The lithium ion battery also comprises an insulating fixing piece 5; the side wall 22 comprises a first surface 221 adjacent to the battery core body 3 and a second surface 222 opposite to the first surface 221, a through hole 220 is arranged on the side wall 22, and the insulating fixing piece 5 covers the inner wall of the through hole 220 and partially extends to cover the first surface 221 and the second surface 222; the pole 4 includes a first abutting portion 41, a second abutting portion 42, and a connecting portion 43, the connecting portion 43 fills the through hole, the first abutting portion 41 abuts against a portion of the insulating fixing 5 covering the first surface 221, and the second abutting portion 42 abuts against a portion of the insulating fixing 5 covering the second surface 222. Through the setting of this kind of structure for utmost point post 4 is insulating with lateral wall 22, because utmost point post 4 is connected with first utmost point ear leading-out terminal 32, and diapire 21 is connected with second utmost point ear leading-out terminal 31, and diapire 21 and lateral wall 22 contact have consequently realized that first utmost point ear leading-out terminal 32 and second utmost point ear leading-out terminal 31's insulating setting has improved lithium ion battery's reliability.

It should be noted that the insulating fixing member 5 may be an integral injection molding material, and the material of the insulating fixing member 5 is not specifically limited in this embodiment; in addition, the thickness of the insulating fixing member 5 is not specifically limited in this embodiment, and may be set according to actual requirements.

The orthographic projection of the first abutting portion 41 on the side wall 22 and the orthographic projection of the second abutting portion 42 on the side wall 22 are both within the orthographic projection of the insulating fixing member on the side wall 22. That is, the first abutting portion 41 and the second abutting portion 42 do not contact the side wall 22, or have a gap with the side wall 22, and the insulating between the post 4 and the side wall 22 is further ensured by the arrangement of such a structure, thereby improving the reliability of the lithium ion battery.

Compared with the related art, the embodiment of the utility model has at least the following advantages:

the pole 4 is arranged on the side wall 22 of the lower metal shell 2 in an insulating mode, the first pole tab leading-out end 32 is connected with the pole 4, and the second pole tab leading-out end 31 is connected with the bottom wall 21, so that the lithium ion battery can normally work on one hand, and the normal use of the lithium ion battery is not influenced; on the other hand, the pole 4 does not occupy the space of the lithium ion battery in the battery height direction X, so that the accommodating space 20 can accommodate the battery core body 3 with a larger size, the capacity of the battery is larger, and the overall energy density and the endurance time of the lithium ion battery are further improved.

EXAMPLE five

Fig. 9 to fig. 10 are schematic structural diagrams of a lithium ion battery according to a fifth embodiment of the present invention, and the lithium ion battery of the present embodiment is substantially the same as the lithium ion battery according to the first embodiment, and mainly has the following differences: in the present embodiment, the liquid inlet 10 is provided in the side wall 22 and spaced apart from the electrode post 4.

Referring to fig. 10, specifically, the inner wall of the liquid filling hole 10 is also covered with an insulating material, and the lithium ion battery further includes an insulating member 6, wherein the insulating member 6 covers the inner wall and a part of the side wall 22 of the liquid filling hole 10. Because the electrolyte is easy to corrode metal, the electrolyte does not contact with the side wall 22 when the liquid is injected into the liquid injection hole 10 through the arrangement of the structure, and therefore the stability of the lithium ion battery is improved.

It can be understood that the insulating member 6 may be an integral injection molding material, and the embodiment does not specifically limit the material of the insulating member 6; in addition, the thickness of the insulating member 6 is not specifically limited in this embodiment, and may be set according to actual requirements.

It should be noted that the inner wall of the liquid filling hole 10 may not be coated with an insulating material, and the liquid filling hole 10 may be directly sealed by a metal member.

Referring to fig. 9, the upper metal shell 1 and the lower metal shell 2 may be circular or arc-shaped. It should be noted that, in this embodiment, the shapes of the upper metal shell 1 and the lower metal shell 2 are not specifically limited, and the upper metal shell 1 and the lower metal shell 2 may also be in other shapes such as a semicircle shape and a rectangular shape, and may be set according to actual requirements.

EXAMPLE six

Through setting up insulating tape 7, can effectively avoid anodal and negative pole contact to cause the short circuit of lithium ion battery.

It should be noted that the insulating tape 7 in this embodiment is a brown insulating tape, and insulation can be achieved at the first electrode tab leading-out end 32 and the second electrode tab leading-out end 31 by means of pasting, so that the process flow of the lithium ion battery is simplified.

Referring to fig. 11, an insulating tape 7 is disposed between the upper metal case 1 and the battery core 3.

Referring to fig. 12, an insulating tape 7 is provided between the lower metal case 2 and the battery core 3.

Referring to fig. 13, insulating tapes 7 are respectively provided between the upper metal case 1 and the battery core 3, and between the lower metal case 2 and the battery core 3.

Note that, the battery body 3 in the present embodiment is formed by winding.

Example twelve

Fig. 29 to fig. 31 are three views of a partial structure of a lithium ion battery according to a twelfth embodiment of the present invention, which is a further improvement on the basis of the first embodiment, and the specific improvement is that: the lithium ion battery also comprises a pressure relief groove 8; the pressure relief groove 8 is provided on the side of the upper metal case 1 adjacent to the battery core 3, and/or the pressure relief groove 8 is provided on the side of the side wall 22 adjacent to the battery core 3, and/or the pressure relief groove 8 is provided on the side of the bottom wall 21 adjacent to the battery core 3.

Fig. 29 is a top view of the upper metal shell 1. The pressure relief groove 8 is provided on the side of the upper metal case 1 adjacent to the battery core 3. Specifically, the ratio of the groove depth of the pressure relief groove 8 to the thickness of the upper metal shell 1 is greater than or equal to 0.25 and less than or equal to 0.95.

Fig. 30 is a side view of the sidewall 22. The pressure relief groove 8 is provided on the side of the side wall 22 adjacent to the battery core 3. Specifically, the ratio of the groove depth of the pressure relief groove 8 to the thickness of the side wall 22 is 0.25 or more and 0.95 or less.

Fig. 31 is a top view of the bottom wall 21. The pressure relief groove 8 is provided on the side of the bottom wall 21 adjacent to the battery core 3. Specifically, the ratio of the groove depth of the pressure relief groove 8 to the thickness of the bottom wall 21 is 0.25 or more and 0.95 or less.

Through the arrangement of the structure, on one hand, the internal pressure of the lithium ion battery can be effectively relieved, and the lithium ion battery is prevented from expanding even exploding due to overlarge internal pressure; on the other hand, the structural strength of the shell provided with the pressure relief groove 8 is not affected, and the structural stability of the lithium ion battery is ensured.

It should be noted that the shapes of the pressure relief grooves 8 shown in fig. 29 to 31 are all curved, and in practical applications, the shapes of the pressure relief grooves are not specifically limited, and may be broken lines or other shapes, and may be set according to practical requirements.

It should be noted that, in this embodiment, the arrangement position of the pressure relief groove 8 is not specifically limited, and only the connection positions between the pole 4 and the housing and the connection positions between the second pole tab leading-out end 31 and the housing need to be arranged at intervals.

It should be further noted that, in this embodiment, the number of the pressure relief grooves 8 is not specifically limited, and different numbers of pressure relief grooves 8 may be provided according to actual requirements.

Preferably, the groove width of the pressure relief groove is greater than or equal to 0.15 mm, and less than or equal to 0.5 mm. The arrangement of the width range can lead the pressure relief groove 8 to relieve pressure without influencing the structural strength of the lithium ion battery shell.

It should be noted that in the twelve embodiments, the insulating tape 7 and the pressure relief groove 8 may be disposed in any embodiment; the battery core 3 in any of the embodiments may be formed by winding or stacking.

Compared with the related art, the embodiment of the utility model has at least the following advantages: because the welding mode of the positive pole lug is designed at the top of the battery from the traditional positive pole insulation part and the positive pole polarity center column, the side wall of the lower metal shell of the battery is changed into the side wall, the size of the height space of the battery is saved, the size of the height space is saved, the size of the pole piece width inside the battery is utilized, the pole piece width of the battery is widened to be equal to the capacity of the battery, the following table I and table II are used as a comparison table for checking the capacity of the battery with the same volume according to the scheme of the embodiment and the prior traditional technology, and the capacity is about higher than the whole size of the battery with the same volume in the prior art: 3% -8%, the scheme of improving the energy density of the battery is achieved, and therefore the battery endurance using effect and time are greatly improved.

For the sake of easy understanding, the preparation process of the lithium ion battery of this embodiment is specifically described below:

(1) the battery core body comprises a first pole tab leading-out end and a second pole tab leading-out end.

(2) And sticking the first pole lug leading-out end and the second pole lug leading-out end through a brown insulating adhesive tape for insulation.

(3) The first pole ear leading-out end is welded at the positive pole polarity position at the side wall pole position of the battery core through ultrasonic after being bent and rubberized, and the second pole ear leading-out end is welded at the center position of the metal shell under the negative pole through ultrasonic after being bent and rubberized.

(4) The upper metal shell comprises a liquid injection hole: after the welding of the first pole lug leading-out end and the second pole lug leading-out end is finished, the upper metal shell and the lower metal shell are welded through laser ultrasonic waves, and after liquid is injected through the liquid injection port, the liquid injection port is sealed through the laser ultrasonic welding, so that the internal part of the battery is sealed with the outside; the upper metal shell has no liquid injection hole: after the welding of the first pole lug leading-out end and the second pole lug leading-out end is completed, the battery is filled with liquid into the opening of the battery in a specific environment of temperature and humidity of the glove box, the liquid is filled, the upper metal shell and the lower metal shell are welded through laser ultrasonic waves, and the sealing between the inside of the battery and the outside is realized.

(5) After the above steps are completed, the air tightness is tested to form a semi-finished button type lithium ion battery.
